findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70% for embedded-post author links
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, which is lighter and lower contrast. The dark branch is `$secondary` at 30%, which matches the 70% value instead. The PR is only meant to add a dark-theme variant, so light themes should keep 30% (dark: `$secondary` 70%). As written, `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` regresses on every light theme.

findings.title: group-member-info .name lightness changed from 30% to 50% in both branches
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new rule uses 50%/50%, which looks copy-pasted from the `.title` rule below it. This changes the light-theme color and removes the intended visual distinction between the name (darker) and the title (lighter). It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: custom-message-length light-theme lightness changed from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light branch moved from 70% to 30%, so light themes get a much darker hint text than before. The desktop counterpart in `desktop/modal.scss` correctly uses 70%/30%. The mobile rule should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: topic-map h3 color changed from 20% to 50%/50%
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new rule uses `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` for the light branch, which silently lightens the heading on light themes. The dark branch is `$secondary` at 50%, which is also wrong. It should be 20%/80%, as in the desktop `.topic-map h3` and the mobile `.number, i` rules.

findings.title: group-member-info .name lightness changed from 30% to 50% in both branches
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new rule is 50%/50%, which alters the light-theme appearance and makes `.name` identical to `.title`. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Remaining raw scale-color($primary) not converted
findings.body: `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still uses `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` directly. On dark themes it gets the same low-contrast color this PR is meant to fix. It should use `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` like the rest.
